title: Shutdown Logic Start Date and Ramp lines of Plan QA ETM-8042 8836

steps.do: Open Logic page, collapse histogram, expand Scheduled group, read Start Date of earliest row
steps.expected: Earliest Start Date is 15 Feb 2026 (Plan Ramp Down), not 08 Feb 2026
steps.why: Start Date column read from the screen: first row 15 Feb 2026, 09:00; all 36 rendered date cells are 15 Feb 2026 09:00 or 10:00 (grid is virtualized, only rendered rows read); no 08 Feb value.

steps.do: Gantt day level, hover Ramp Down line
steps.why: Tooltip reads 'Ramp Down: 15 Feb 2026' (date only, no time). At day level the line is at the left edge of day column 15; at hour level (initial state) the line sat at the left edge of the 09:00 column under header Sun 15/02. Date matches; the time 09:00 is not shown as text, only by position.

steps.do: Scroll Gantt to 25 Feb, hover Ramp Up line
steps.why: Tooltip reads 'Ramp Up: 25 Feb 2026' (date only, no time). Day column 25 spans x=1027-1127, line at x=1102, i.e. 3/4 of the day = 18:00 by position. Date matches; time not shown as text.
